_comment: NOT ACTIVE. Copy this to .claude/settings.json to switch it on:
It is inert on purpose. These rules widen what a session may do without asking, and an agent
must not be able to widen its own permissions, so the harness refuses to let a session write its
own active settings file. You activate it; a session never does. See .claude/README.md.
permissions.allow pre-approves only the three read-only desk commands (the proof gate, the ledger
read, the rulebook-completeness check), so they stop prompting. The write/network commands
(desk:rank, desk:crawl, desk:ledger, desk:card) are left out on purpose and still ask.
permissions.deny keeps .env and its local variants away from the Read tool, matching the studio
repo. This repo keeps No secrets, ever (CLAUDE.md), so there should be nothing to read; the rule
is defence in depth for Mac and cloud sessions alike. .env.example (names only) stays readable.
